qualifier: steroid metabolism, sulfonation and SLCO organic anion uptake
name: Drug and steroid metabolism with SLCO organic anion uptake
rationale: Members cover drug ADME, xenobiotic and steroid metabolism, cytosolic sulfonation and sodium-independent SLCO organic anion transport; the drug ADME/SLCO uptake set separates it from oxidative detoxification confusables, and sulfonation/steroid metabolism from bilirubin glucuronidation and xenobiotic export confusables.

qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone
name: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone signaling
rationale: Members are growth hormone, prolactin and leptin JAK-STAT receptor signaling, thyroid hormone generation, transport and response, and organism growth/lifespan regulation; thyroid hormone and GH/prolactin/leptin content separates it from glucagon/somatostatin, IGF and IL-6-family cytokine confusables.

qualifier: thermal and mechanical nociceptive stimulus detection
name: Thermal and mechanical nociception and pain behavior
rationale: Members concern detection of thermal and mechanical noxious stimuli, behavioral response to pain and its positive regulation via action potential firing, which distinguishes it from confusables centred on potassium channels and membrane potential.

qualifier: plus calcium-activated phospholipid scrambling
name: Organelle acidification and phospholipid scrambling
rationale: Members combine V-ATPase-driven acidification of Golgi, endosome, lysosome and synaptic vesicle lumens with aminophospholipid translocation and ANO6 calcium-activated scrambling; the scrambling arm is what the pH-regulation confusables lack.

qualifier: naive/memory B cell surface and plasma cell immunoglobulin
name: Naive, memory B cell and plasma cell immunoglobulin signatures
rationale: Members are B cell, naive and memory B cell surface and plasma cell immunoglobulin expression modules plus plasma cell and germinal center differentiation; these signature modules distinguish it from confusables built on B cell activation, ICOS/Tfh co-stimulation or TBA modules.

qualifier: B cell homeostasis and restraint of B cell proliferation
name: Germinal center B cell responses and B cell homeostasis
rationale: Members cover germinal center formation, Tfh/ICOS help, GC B cell differentiation and memory responses together with B cell homeostasis and negative regulation of B cell proliferation and apoptosis, which the B cell signature and activation confusables lack.

qualifier: heme scavenging and transferrin endocytosis
name: Heme scavenging and transferrin-mediated iron uptake
rationale: All members concern acquiring iron in bound form, via plasma heme scavenging/heme transport or transferrin endocytosis with DMT1 (SLC11A2) endosomal export, distinguishing it from confusables about free iron ion import, copper/manganese or cadmium handling.

qualifier: tooth formation and ectodysplasin/NF-kB-linked ectodermal dysplasia
name: Odontogenesis and ectodermal dysplasia-linked appendage development
rationale: Members cover tooth development (odontoblast differentiation, dentinogenesis, cementum, eruption), hair placode formation and EDA-ID/TNF-receptor NF-kB defects, which together separate it from enamel mineralization and skin/keratinocyte confusables.

qualifier: positive and negative regulation of alpha and beta receptors
name: Regulation of PDGF receptor alpha and beta signaling
rationale: Nearly all members are response to PDGF and up/down regulation of PDGFR-alpha and -beta signaling, alongside a mesenchymal YAP/TAZ fibroblast module; the explicit PDGFR regulation is what the fibroblast-stroma and Hippo confusables lack.

qualifier: IL-3/IL-5 signaling with CBL-mediated FLT3 and G-CSF attenuation
name: IL-3/IL-5 signaling and CBL-mediated FLT3 attenuation
rationale: Members are IL-3 and IL-5 receptor signaling plus negative regulation of FLT3 (CBL, SRC kinases) and G-CSF signaling, distinguishing it from STAT5/oncogenic RTK fusion, erythropoietin and common-gamma-chain cytokine confusables.

qualifier: blood group antigens and sulfated selectin ligands
name: Fucosylated blood group and selectin ligand biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover GDP-fucose synthesis and SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transport, ABO/Lewis antigen synthesis, protein tyrosine sulfation and selectin-dependent leukocyte rolling and stem cell homing, distinguishing it from N/O-glycan and glycosphingolipid confusables.

qualifier: BMAL1:CLOCK activation and CRY:PER repression
name: Core BMAL1:CLOCK–CRY:PER circadian transcriptional feedback loop
rationale: All members describe BMAL1/CLOCK expression, modification and nuclear entry, activation of clock genes and their repression by CRY:PER kinase complexes, separating it from ROR/REV-ERB-PGC-1alpha metabolic and MECP2/NPAS4 neuronal confusables.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, transmembrane transport and catabolism
name: Glutathione synthesis, transport and catabolism
rationale: All members concern glutathione synthesis (GCLC, GSS), recycling, GGT1 catabolism, glutathione and cystine transport; synthesis and transport distinguish it from gamma-glutamyl-cycle defect confusables, and the glutathione focus from ferroptosis/redox homeostasis confusables.

qualifier: arterial, venous and lymphatic specification
name: Arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial specification and vasculogenesis
rationale: Members cover endothelial fate commitment and differentiation into arterial and lymphatic types, venous and aortic morphogenesis, vessel maturation and CNS vasculogenesis plus an endothelial identity module, distinguishing it from heart, outflow tract and BMP-driven cardiac confusables.

core: Negative regulation of inflammatory cytokine production
qualifier: IL-1 beta, IL-6 and TNF
name: Suppression of proinflammatory IL-1β, IL-6 and TNF production
rationale: All four members are negative regulation of production of inflammatory cytokines IL-1 beta, IL-6 and TNF-superfamily cytokines, distinguishing it from confusables about T cell cytokines (IL-2, IL-10, IL-12, IL-21) or Toll/IL-1 signaling.

qualifier: iron-sulfur cluster assembly; complexes I, III and ATP synthase
name: Iron-sulfur cluster and respiratory complex I/III/V assembly
rationale: Members are Fe-S cluster assembly (cytosolic, 2Fe-2S, 4Fe-4S, TCA enzyme maturation), inner-membrane protein insertion and assembly of complex I, complex III and ATP synthase; Fe-S assembly distinguishes it from complex IV, mitochondrial translation and electron transport confusables.

qualifier: HRI/GCN2 kinases and mitochondrial unfolded protein response
name: HRI/GCN2 integrated stress response and mitochondrial UPR
rationale: Members concern stress-induced control of translation initiation via eIF2-alpha kinases HRI and GCN2 (heme and amino acid deficiency), the mitochondrial UPR and general UPR; the HRI/GCN2 and mitochondrial arm distinguishes it from ATF6/IRE1/PERK ER-stress confusables.

qualifier: renin-angiotensin and endothelin vasoconstriction
name: Blood pressure control by angiotensin and endothelin vasoconstriction
rationale: Members cover renin-angiotensin signaling, endothelin, neural and renal control of arterial and pulmonary pressure and regulation of vasoconstriction, distinguishing it from natriuretic/cGMP, renal sodium excretion and NO smooth-muscle relaxation confusables.

qualifier: cerebellar granule layer and forebrain neuron specification
name: Cerebellar granule layer and forebrain neuron development
rationale: Members cover cerebellar granular layer formation, granule precursor proliferation, Bergmann glia and motor learning together with thalamus, pyramidal neuron and forebrain neuron-type commitment; the cerebellar granule/Bergmann arm and forebrain specification separate it from cortical migration, Purkinje/locomotor, L1 axon tract and retina confusables.

core: Hindbrain and spinal cord neural development
qualifier: motor neuron specification and cranial nerve/ganglion formation
name: Hindbrain, spinal cord and cranial nerve neuron development
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/brainstem/pons development and migration, dorsoventral spinal cord patterning with motor neuron and interneuron specification, cranial nerves, cranial and dorsal root ganglia and brainstem-controlled behaviors, distinguishing it from midbrain dopaminergic, enteric/autonomic, neural plate and sympathetic confusables.

qualifier: HIF-alpha prolyl hydroxylation and HIF-driven transcription
name: Oxygen sensing by HIF prolyl hydroxylation
rationale: All members concern oxygen homeostasis through oxygen-dependent prolyl hydroxylation of HIF-alpha and HIF-1alpha-regulated gene expression, which none of the erythropoiesis, TCA cycle or NRF2 confusables contain.

qualifier: E-cadherin and cadherin-11
name: Transcriptional control of E-cadherin and cadherin-11 genes
rationale: All three members are positive or negative transcriptional regulation of CDH1 (E-cadherin) or CDH11 genes, distinguishing it from generic transcription repression, SMAD/mesenchymal, gastrulation EMT and RUNX3 confusables.

qualifier: bidirectional control of VEGF/FGF production and endothelial responses
name: Bidirectional regulation of sprouting angiogenesis and VEGF/FGF production
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of sprouting angiogenesis, endothelial proliferation, migration, chemotaxis and apoptosis, VEGF/FGF production and VEGFR signaling and vascular wound healing, distinguishing it from Tie2, VEGFR2 ligand-binding and vessel remodeling confusables.

qualifier: rod and cone cycles and their LRAT/RDH enzyme defects
name: Retinoid visual cycle in rods and cones
rationale: Members are the rod and cone retinoid cycles, vitamin A metabolism and phototransduction defects from LRAT, RDH5 and RDH12 loss, distinguishing it from general retinol metabolism/STRA6 uptake and A2E/ABCA4 confusables.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt signaling
qualifier: retinal vascular and blood-brain barrier formation
name: Wnt secretion, non-canonical Wnt and blood-retinal barrier formation
rationale: Members combine Wnt ligand biogenesis/PORCN-dependent secretion, WNT5A-Ca2+ non-canonical signaling and FZD internalization with retinal vessel morphogenesis, RPE development and blood-retina/blood-brain barrier establishment; the vascular-barrier arm distinguishes it from canonical Wnt, Hedgehog lipidation and planar polarity confusables.
